title: GovTech's workforce transformation and the 93 officers retrenched in its first phase
asked: Six MPs asked about GovTech's restructuring: whether the Government was consulted, how the 93 retrenched officers were selected by age, tenure and role, whether redeployment and retraining were exhausted first, and what support and monitoring the officers get.
asked_by: Assoc Prof Kenneth Goh; Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan; Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis; Mr Low Wu Yang Andre; Mr Sharael Taha; Mr Yip Hon Weng
response: The Ministry was consulted on GovTech's workforce transformation plan and supports it; the shift is from one-off project delivery to continuous product ownership, to be implemented progressively over two years. In the first phase, 305 officers are affected: 102 retained or redeployed, 110 on structured job conversion and apprenticeship pathways, and 93 retrenched. GovTech first assessed the roles it needs, then assessed individual officers on competencies, domain expertise, job fit and readiness, and is working with the Public Service Division, WSG and e2i on more than 300 job opportunities. All 93 are still on GovTech payroll and will be monitored through job placement efforts.

key_points.point: The Ministry was consulted on the plan and supports it.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: The Ministry was consulted on GovTech's workforce transformation plan and we support it.

key_points.point: The transformation runs progressively over two years so officers have time to adjust.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: The transformation will be implemented progressively over two years to give officers time to adjust.

key_points.point: The first phase affects 305 GovTech officers.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: The first phase will affect 305 GovTech officers.

key_points.point: Of the 305: 102 retained or redeployed, 110 on job conversion and apprenticeship pathways, 93 retrenched.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: 102 officers have been retained or redeployed into roles where their skill sets are still required; 110 are being supported through structured job conversion and apprenticeship pathways; and 93 are being retrenched.

key_points.point: The largest age group among the 93 exiting officers is 40 to 49.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: Among the 93 exiting officers, the largest age group is 40 to 49.

key_points.point: Median tenure is 5.4 years for exiting officers versus 6.0 years for those on retraining pathways.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: The exiting officers have served for a median of 5.4 years, compared to a median of 6.0 years for the officers on retraining pathways.

key_points.point: Two-thirds of affected officers were individual contributors; one-third were Team Leaders.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: two-thirds of the affected officers were individual contributors and one-third of the affected officers were Team Leaders

key_points.point: More than 300 relevant job opportunities were identified with PSD, WSG and e2i.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: Together, we identified a good mix of more than 300 job opportunities that are relevant to the affected officers' competencies.

key_points.point: Retraining and redeployment were considered before external recruitment where a suitable pathway existed.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: Where there was a suitable pathway, GovTech has retrained and redeployed its officers before considering external recruitment.

key_points.point: Apprenticeship pathways run 12 to 18 months full-time in a product team with a mentor and a conversion assessment at the end.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: our apprenticeships that we run for officers that have to go into new roles, they run from between 12 and 18 months

key_points.point: All 93 retrenched officers remain on GovTech payroll while they hand over work and look for other roles.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: All 93 officers are still on GovTech payroll.

key_points.point: About 30% of affected workers are above age 50.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: On the proportion of affected workers above the age of 50, I believe the number is about 30%.

key_points.point: GovTech will monitor the 93 officers and any future retrenched officers through job placement efforts.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: we intend to monitor all of them, all 93 of them

key_points.point: The same approach will be used in subsequent phases.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: GovTech will take the same approach in subsequent phases.

left_open: How many of the 93 retrenched officers have secured new employment so far.
Whether the monitoring of affected officers' outcomes will be published.
Whether Singapore currently has a sufficient pipeline of digital product management and product ownership talent.
Whether the skills gaps and agency needs for future restructuring phases will be assessed and announced in advance.
supplementary: Talent attraction and morale, contract staff, redeployment timing, and how AI is reshaping GovTech's future workforce.
